answer_1.quote: Research on enabling a machine to have meaningful and natural conversations with humans plays a fundamental role in developing artificial general intelligence... Recently open-domain or non-task-oriented dialogue systems have attracted a surge of research interest.

answer_2.quote: we propose holistic metrics that evaluate distinctive aspects of generated dialogues... Both context coherence and response fluency (quality metrics) can naturally be captured by metrics based on strong language models like GPT-2... we utilize n-gram based entropy to capture response diversity and entailment based approach to capture logical self-consistency.

answer_3.quote: Both context coherence and response fluency (quality metrics) can naturally be captured by metrics based on strong language models like GPT-2... the context coherence is defined as the loglikelihood of the response conditional on the query... the raw response fluency score is defined as negative perplexity of generated responses.

answer_4.quote: we utilize Amazon Turk to collect high quality human ratings from 10 subjects... each datapoint is to be rated from 1 to 5, with 1 being the worst and 5 being the best on each metric.
answer_4.guideline: rate from 1 to 5 on context coherence, response fluency, response diversity, and logical self-consistency
